title: Extended Toda tau-functions as KP tau-functions at fixed lattice and logarithmic-flow parameters
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author constructs paired formal wave functions for the additional logarithmic Toda flows, proves parameter-independent Wronskian normalization, factors the matrix-resolvent n-point kernel, and extracts a Sato affine-coordinate expansion. This compatibility between two hierarchies is the retained core; the final invocation of the KP criterion alone is not counted.
author: Di Yang; Jian Zhou
